electronics.webp.note: Illustrative PCB assembly environment. Not a customer reference or a photograph of a CNT700x floor. Genuine product textures are displayed separately.
electronics.webp.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: a single editorial environment photograph for the application section of a premium Turkish conductive PVC flooring website. Primary request: a credible modern electronics manufacturing and PCB assembly laboratory, photographed as architectural editorial photography, not science-fiction. Scene: immaculate production hall, rows of understated white SMT assembly equipment, a few neat ESD workstations and a small visible green PCB on a workbench, glass partitions, precision-engineering atmosphere. Camera eye height 1.5m with natural 28mm architectural lens, strong but calm perspective, foreground floor and aisle across lower third, production equipment clearly visible in middle and background. No people needed. Palette: neutral white, pale grey, deep navy structural details, very restrained muted green from circuit boards. Soft directional daylight combined with practical linear ceiling lighting, natural contrast and photographic grain, physically plausible surfaces and realistic equipment proportions. Floor should be plain smooth light grey with NO invented flecks, NO visible printed designs, NO patterns; this is an environment illustration, not a product texture sample. Composition: landscape 3:2, entire photo filled with scene, editorial crop, no frame, equipment clear in the upper two-thirds so room is recognizable at small size. No text, no logos, no labels, no cyan energy lines, no orange glowing effects, no holograms, no excessive bokeh, no glossy CGI appearance. Generate one finished high-resolution photograph-style environment image.
